title: CockroachDB transactions and retries
brief: Use CockroachDB’s transaction protocol and client error contract to execute one logical purchase safely.
outcomes: Relate intents and transaction state to atomic visibility
Handle native retry and ambiguous-result paths without repeating external work
entry: General distributed commit, request identity and CockroachDB ranges.

heading.title: A distributed purchase
heading.brief: Place order and inventory keys across ranges and trace intents and transaction records under the tested version.

heading.title: The commit decision
heading.brief: Explain Parallel Commits, staging, proof of committed writes and asynchronous resolution with a labelled conceptual trace; distinguish this from textbook two-phase commit.

heading.title: Known retry errors
heading.brief: Implement the pinned driver’s complete-transaction retry path, preserving one request identity and a bounded budget; distinguish server-internal retries.

heading.title: An ambiguous result
heading.brief: Exercise or clearly model connection loss near commit; resolve the original purchase identity on an authoritative read and never repeat provider effects blindly.
